name: Punjab High-Yield Alluvial Farm
description: Fertile alluvial soil with high nitrogen, warm summer monsoon climate, and abundant irrigation.

name: Haryana Winter Wheat Basin
description: Cool winter conditions, moderate moisture, fertile loamy soil, ideal for winter cereals.

name: Vidarbha Black Cotton Tract
description: Deep black vertisol soil with high potassium, warm monsoon temperatures, moderate rainfall.

name: Malwa Plateau Pulse Farm
description: Cool dry winter weather, low rainfall, moderate phosphorus-rich soil suited for nitrogen-fixing legumes.

name: Semi-Arid Rajasthan Mustard Field
description: Light sandy loam, low rainfall, cool winter nights, suitable for drought-hardy oilseeds.

name: Karnataka Red Loam Maize Zone
description: Red loamy soil, moderate rainfall and temperature, suitable for high-yielding C4 cereal.

name: Himachal Apple Valley Orchard
description: High altitude valley, cool temperate temperatures, moderate well-distributed rainfall, rich organic loam.

name: Wayanad Plantation Estate
description: Hilly terrain, porous volcanic loam, high rainfall and humidity with cool tropical climate.
